import { it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { observe, event, sleep, signal, waitFor } from './observe.mjs';
let calls = 0;
it('[REQ-393][K01] custom cleanup retains origin until delegation settlement', { timeout: 100, retry: 1 }, async ctx => {
  const invocation = calls++, b = observe('K01', invocation, ctx);
  if (invocation === 0) {
    await sleep(140);
    ctx.onTestFinished(() => event('K01', invocation, 'native-snapshot', ctx));
    await b(() => expect(1).toBe(1), 'cleanup-first');
    await sleep(130);
    await waitFor('K01-retry');
    await b(() => expect(1).toBe(1), 'after-delegation');
    signal('K01-late');
  } else await b(async () => { signal('K01-retry'); await sleep(70); await waitFor('K01-late'); }, 'retry');
});
it('[REQ-393][Z99] settle custom cleanup callbacks', { timeout: 1000 }, async () => { await sleep(400); });
